title: AH It's Coming Out (Golden Freddy)
blurb: The Golden Freddy edition of the panicked 'AH, IT'S COMING OUT' clip — FNAF's most mysterious animatronic crossed with one of the internet's most chaotic screams. It's exactly the kind of unhinged crossover the FNAF fandom produces at industrial scale. Genuinely startling, entirely unserious, and beloved by both communities.
origin: A FNAF fandom remix combining Golden Freddy with a viral panic clip.
